egg.flavorText: It is an egg from an avian creature. There is no creature inside.

pastaDough.flavorText: Dough, but just a bit different

indigoSeeds.flavorText: A classic flavoring agent, common on planets with low amounts of water. Cook it!

indigoSpice.flavorText: A classic flavoring agent. Has a smoky flavor!

indigoPasta.flavorText: Noodles with a little more kick!

overslicedScraps.flavorText: Its sliced to the point of unrecognizability, turning into a fine dust. Throw this out the window!

mix.flavorText: A little bit of this, and a little bit of that.

omelette.flavorText: There was an egg here. It is now an omelette.

sweetRoll.flavorText: Its called a sweet roll instead of sweet bread because sweetbread means something else apparently

milk.flavorText: It looks, smells, tastes, and feels like milk. Except it probably doesn't come from an earth cow.
